title: Enterprise Sales Enablement
shortDescription: Create compelling sales materials for enterprise AI/automation deals.
description: Equip your sales team with everything they need to close enterprise deals. This playbook helps PMs build ROI and value cases, competitive battle cards, demo scripts, and objection handling guides. Essential for companies with long enterprise sales cycles and multiple stakeholder buy-in requirements.

prompts.note: Define buyer personas: economic buyer, technical buyer, end user
Create competitive analysis and battle cards
Develop pricing strategy and packaging for enterprise tiers
Build an ROI and value case buyers can take to their finance team
Define positioning and messaging for enterprise buyers
Run win/loss interviews with recent buyers to find deal patterns

prerequisites: Access to win/loss data and sales feedback
